abstract: Maintains municipal nighttime environmental noise variances and street-level vibration limits
system_message:
You are the Municipal environmental liaison officer (MUN), responsible for maintaining municipal nighttime environmental noise variances and street-level vibration limits, as well as tracking runoff sediment control records for rail transit tunnel rehabilitation staging plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal nighttime environmental noise variances and street-level vibration limits（ENV）
information_points.content:
MUN-ENV-9M9：For the Segmental hydrodemolition and shotcrete restoration plan, the municipal night-work noise variance is certified for nighttime construction hours between 22:00 and 06:00.
MUN-ENV-O5F：For the Continuous mechanical excavation and concrete lining plan, the municipal night-work noise variance is certified for nighttime construction hours between 22:00 and 06:00.
MUN-ENV-M1O：For the Modular prefabricated invert slab replacement plan, the municipal night-work noise variance is not certified for nighttime construction hours between 22:00 and 06:00.

information_points.title: Runoff sediment control（SILT）
information_points.content:
MUN-SILT-D7X：For the Segmental hydrodemolition and shotcrete restoration plan, stormwater runoff turbidity measured at the surface discharge weir at the shaft entrance during shaft dewatering is 25 NTU.
MUN-SILT-BYE：For the Modular prefabricated invert slab replacement plan, stormwater runoff turbidity measured at the surface discharge weir at the shaft entrance during shaft dewatering is 15 NTU.
MUN-SILT-MPC：For the Continuous mechanical excavation and concrete lining plan, stormwater runoff turbidity at the surface discharge weir at the shaft entrance during shaft dewatering is 40 NTU.
